caseName: Allum v. Second Judicial District Court of Nevada

opinions.text:
510 U.S. 988

Allum
v.
Second Judicial District Court of Nevada et al.

No. 93-6253.

Supreme Court of United States.

November 29, 1993.

1

Appeal from the Sup. Ct. Nev.

2

Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until December 20, 1993, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.
